items.question: What practice did the Buddha-formed one cause to be done after saying thus?
premises: He caused a practice to be done.
items.inference: The verse records the Buddha-formed figure causing practice after his declaration.
uncertainties: The specific ritual practice is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having said thus, the Buddha-formed one caused the practice to be done.
